title: MORA: Correcting Time Series Forecasts with Coarse Future Signals
abstract: arXiv:2611.15413v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent architectural advances have improved time-series forecasting. However, our analysis of forecasters with diverse architectures reveals a common pattern: a substantial share of residual energy is concentrated in a small number of low-frequency components. Simple linear probes further show that the forecasters' historical inputs still contain predictive information about errors in the forecast mean. Building on these findings, we propose Model-Output Residual Adaptation (MORA), a model-agnostic residual adapter that refines the outputs of frozen forecasters without requiring additional inputs. MORA estimates segment-wise means of the target sequence through structural extrapolation and learned estimation, rather than directly predicting backbone-specific residuals. translated_title: MORA：利用粗粒度未来信号校正时间序列预测
translated_abstract: 近期的架构改进提升了时间序列预测的性能。然而，我们对多种不同架构预测器的分析揭示了一个共同模式：相当大比例的残差能量集中在少数低频分量中。简单的线性探针进一步表明，预测器的历史输入中仍然包含关于预测均值误差的可预测信息。基于这些发现，我们提出了模型输出残差自适应（MORA），这是一种与模型无关的残差适配器，能够在不需要额外输入的情况下精炼冻结预测器的输出。MORA 通过结构外推和学习的估计来获得目标序列的分段均值，而不是直接预测特定于骨干网络的残差。然后，它将这些估计值与骨干网络预测的相应统计量之间的差异转化为分阶段校正，并对每次更新进行相应的缩放。
tldr: MORA 是一种模型无关的残差适配器，它通过结构外推和学习的估计来获取目标序列的分段均值作为粗粒度未来信号，并将这些估计与冻结预测器输出统计量之间的差异转化为分阶段校正，从而在不需额外输入的情况下提升时间序列预测精度。
en_tdlr: MORA is a model-agnostic residual adapter that refines the outputs of frozen time-series forecasters by estimating segment-wise means of the target sequence through structural extrapolation and learned estimation, converting discrepancies with the backbone forecast statistics into stagewise corrections without requiring additional inputs.
